He meets those who've battled against flooding and have learned to live with extreme weather events. Along the way, he tells the story of Millican Dalton, the professor of adventure, who ran his own expeditions in the Lake District more than 70 years ago. Paul also heads for the summit of Great Gable, one of the Lake's best-known peaks.

programme.title: Operation Grand Canyon with Dan Snow

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Presenter Liz McIvor tells the story of the people who operated the canal boats carrying fuel and goods around the country. Conditions were tough, days were long. Victorian society began to grow suspicious of these 'outsiders', and they gained reputations for criminality, violence and drinking. But was this really deserved? Liz discovers grisly canal crimes, investigates health and welfare onboard working boats, and looks at why canal children were last on the list to be offered safeguards and formal education. The Victorians eventually championed the needs of children who were forced to labour in factories and mines, but the boat children were often ignored. Liz discovers the campaigners who set out to tackle this injustice, including George Smith of Coalville, Leicestershire, and Sister Mary Ward of Stoke Bruerne.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson explores Lavenham in Suffolk, the best-preserved medieval village in the country. In the 16th century, Lavenham was one of the wealthiest places in England, becoming rich on its woollen cloth industry, but the industry declined and the wealthy abandoned Lavenham. By the 19th century it was a place of poverty, but today it is once more a jewel of a village.

programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia

programme.title: The Secret World of Haute Couture

programme.title: Shark
programme.desc: A look at how an international team of scientists is trying to change people's perceptions of sharks. Their research is revealing that sharks can be sociable and intelligent, and they could even help solve some of the toughest medical challenges of the 21st century. However, the breakthroughs come at a time when many sharks face extinction. Science may now be the only way to save them.

programme.desc: Relive the biggest and best moments from an unforgettable weekend as Radio 2 in the Park made its Scottish debut in spectacular Stirling. Expect huge performances from the likes of Deacon Blue, Appleton, Blue, Cast, James Blunt, Level 42, Texas, Lulu, Jack Savoretti, ABC, The Script, Emeli Sandé and this year’s headliners, the 'queen of funk’ Chaka Khan and local legends Simple Minds, as we celebrate a spectacular two days of incredible live music.

programme.title: The Rolling Stones: Live at the Fonda
programme.desc: This programme captures a truly unique event in the long and eventful history of The Rolling Stones. On 20 May 2015, at the Fonda Theatre in Hollywood, the band performed the entire Sticky Fingers album live in concert for the first, and so far only time, in their career. The show celebrated the reissue of the Sticky Fingers album and was the opening night of the band's Zip Code Tour of North America that would run over the next two months. The intimate setting of the Fonda Theatre was in contrast to the huge stadiums in which the band would perform for the rest of the tour and made this an incredibly special occasion for those fans lucky enough to get a ticket.

programme.title: My Life as a Rolling Stone
programme.desc: Mick Jagger has spent 60 years as frontman for The Rolling Stones. In this documentary, he talks exclusively about his life in the band, from his first performances in local teenage parties to his creation of a stage persona that has defined the rock 'n' roll lead singer, making Jagger a global icon and musical visionary. Featuring vivid archive footage from his astonishing career, a rich soundtrack of Stones classic tracks and interviews with a stellar cast of musicians and those close to the band.

programme.title: My Life as a Rolling Stone
programme.desc: Ronnie Wood is a cultural icon, guitar hero, artist and the living embodiment of the vibrancy of British-born rock 'n' roll. In this documentary, Ronnie talks exclusively about his career in music and his life as a Rolling Stone, with its exhilarating highs and sometimes dangerous lows. Through vivid archive footage, brilliant music and interviews with a stellar cast of musicians, the film reveals how he binds the band together through his musical virtuosity and his irresistible, positive personality.

programme.title: Simon King's Shetland Adventure
programme.desc: Simon King, wildlife cameraman and Springwatch presenter, sets off on an adventure to live on the Shetland Islands with his family through the changing seasons. Simon has travelled the world for 30 years, but his boyhood dream was to visit Shetland. Now he has the chance to film some of the remarkable wildlife and experience the beauty and the wild weather of Britain's most northerly isles. Simon captures footage of killer whales coming in to kill a seal, an Arctic tern colony attacked by a bonxie, and a shy otter family. Simon, his wife Marguerite and two-year-old daughter Savannah settle into a remote cottage, but the winter weather and winds of over 100mph make life tough for them. To celebrate winter, Simon joins the local Shetlanders in their Viking Up Helly Aa festivals, but there is a surprise for him: he is asked to come in drag, dressed as fellow Springwatch presenter Kate Humble. This doesn't stop him enjoying himself or helping to set light to a Viking boat in a genuine Shetland experience.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks for crucial clues that help to explain how and why we have come to dominate life on earth. He traces back the African origins of humans to nearly three million years ago, and along the way he goes into caves in southern France where Stone Age people created imaginative paintings of ice-age animals. He also travels to Papua New Guinea to find some hunter-gatherers who have never before set eyes on white people.

programme.title: Paris Police
programme.desc: Meg Steinheil is discovered bound and gagged, with the bodies of both her husband and mother found nearby. Commissaire Cochefert and Detective Jouin are suspicious of her witness statement. Prefect Lepine attends the laying-in ceremony of Emile Zola at the Pantheon and tells his men to do whatever is necessary to dispel the protesters inflamed at the presence of Alfred Dreyfus. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: Paris Police
programme.desc: A torn-up card provides police with a lead in the case of the Steinheil home invasion, but their resources are stretched when a gunman attempts to assassinate Alfred Dreyfus. Journalist Marcel Hutin ingratiates himself with Jouin, who provides him with a copy of Adolphe Steinheil's autopsy report. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: At the end of a long book-signing tour, Martin Scarsden hopes for a peaceful holiday with his partner Mandy Bond, who is already staying at the local yoga retreat in his home town of Port Silver. On the drive there, he is perplexed by a strange call from his childhood friend Jasper.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: As Martin continues to investigate the events surrounding the murder of his friend Jasper, he and Mandy learn that someone at Hummingbird Beach retreat had spiked her drink. In town, Martin bumps into his uncle Vernon and has pangs of guilt about an old betrayal.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Richard offers Ned's services to Audrey in Brabinger's absence but Ned thinks it is all a plot to remove him from his tied cottage so that the new farm manager can move in. Audrey decides to take her revenge.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Domestic sitcom. Hyacinth and Richard have finally moved into their 'country retreat'. Although Hyacinth views the flat as 'old-world bijou', Richard finds it anything but.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: In this episode, AI Decoded focuses on a technology that's been making headlines for all the wrong reasons: AI-powered smart glasses. Critics have labelled them 'pervert glasses', lawsuits have raised privacy concerns, and some venues have banned them altogether. Yet for many blind and visually impaired users, the same technology is proving transformative, helping people read menus, identify surroundings and navigate the world more easily. Are smart glasses a new surveillance threat, or are we in danger of demonising a technology with the potential to benefit millions? Joining the show are AI ethicist Dr Stephanie Hare, Silkie Carlo of Big Brother Watch and Consumer tech expert Ben Hatton from CCS Insight. We also hear from women concerned about the impact of Meta's smart glasses in a BBC News report.

programme.title: Streets of Gold: Mumbai
programme.desc: It's the day before Holi, the Hindu festival that marks the beginning of Mumbai's scorching summer, a centuries-old celebration where the whole of India showers its streets and people in a rainbow of coloured dye. Young entrepreneur Sudipan Das is hoping plans to hold a ticketed festival for thousands of Mumbai's young revellers will be a success for what is traditionally a free event. Fashion Week is also underway in Mumbai's young and fashionable Bandra district, where we meet fashion models and flatmates, Shimona Nath and Chandani Purohit, both in their early twenties and both walking the runway. Shimona is already the face of India's most established make-up brand, Lakmé, and Chandani is working hard to realise her ambitions of making it as a model and in turn provide a better life for her family. Finally, we meet Yash Bhanage on opening day at Veronica's café in Bandra, in a city where a chapati and a cup of chai cost very little, the younger generation of Bandra think nothing of splashing out huge sums on a flat white and an artisan bagel.

Eric is joined by squadron leader Jon Bond, who tells us all about the history of the iconic RAF team, as well as explaining exactly what it takes to become a Red Arrows pilot. Meanwhile, the reds and blues will need to fly around the expansive buildings of Hemswell Antique Centres if they are to pick up the best items to sell at auction within their allotted hour. At North Hykeham, they will be hoping their items take off under the hammer of auctioneer Colin Young. Catherine Southon is squadron leader for the red team - father and son Steve and Simon - as they are challenged to find an item with a connection to a king. Meanwhile, the blues - sisters Kara and Lisa - are led from the front by their squadron leader, Mark Stacey, tasked with buying an item with a connection to a queen.

programme.title: Garden Rescue

In fact, she’d rather have a traditional cottage garden than what she has. But the team are undaunted, and Chris and Lee want to release her from her brick nightmare! After Marie chooses Chris’s design, it's on with turning the new build plot into a bit of country charm.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s round 4 in the antiques face-off between auctioneer Natasha Raskin Sharp and dealer David Harper, motoring through County Durham and North Yorkshire in their bucking 1975 Ford Bronco. With the competition heating up, the pair are on the hunt for treasures that could turn heads at auction. David hopes to pour out a profit with a fancy Asian vessel, and another from closer to home that keeps things hot. Meanwhile, Tash finds a French fancy from the Paris exposition and some historic football match memorabilia, still in mint condition in the box. Could that hit the back of the net with the bidders in the sale room? Taking a break from the buying, Tash and David dive into Durham's culinary history, discovering an enterprising 17th-century woman who created a hot store-cupboard staple that’s still popular to this day. Our pair try their hand at making this famous fiery condiment, but is it too hot for Tash to handle? With their finds loaded and auction day looming, who will be raising the trophy, and who’ll be drowning their sorrows?

Taking a break from the shops, our pair step back in time, discovering the work that goes into keeping a collection of World War II military motors ticking over. David channels the spirit of Steve McQueen, and there's a surprise in store that has Tash and David ducking for cover! With their final auction looming, which one will win the week? Will those quirky curiosities soar in the saleroom or be cast adrift on troubled waters?

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: A sci-fi fan wants to sell his rare and valuable collection of toys to fund a dream holiday for his family. David spent a considerable amount of time in hospital as a child, born with a condition affecting his muscles and joints. He found escape from the world around him in sci-fi, and the joy his Star Wars figures and toys gave him as a child continued as he grew older, and he expanded the collection. Four decades on, David's mobility has become limited, and he's become dependent on his wife, Sarah. Now, he wants to repay his family's sacrifices by selling his beloved collection to fund a dream holiday. He knows his Colchester home has boxes of treasured collectibles, but he's uncertain of their financial value. Auctioneer Izzie Balmer has just one day to work her way through an intergalactic world of sci-fi as she trawls through David's specialist collection. She hopes a surprise find in the loft could lead to a shock at auction. Meanwhile, JJ Chalmers finds the right tools in the blue van to fix an old tricycle, and he makes a musical sewing table sing once again. It’s their last chance to prove they have what it takes, by showing true passion and creativity with their dishes. Who amongst this year’s finalists is the true cooking star and worthy of a place in the Celebrity MasterChef hall of fame? Only one can be crowned Celebrity MasterChef Champion 2026.

programme.title: Mary at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: Sports broadcaster Gabby Logan joins Dame Mary in the kitchen to cook some of her standout time-saving recipes. Gabby asks Mary to share her own tales of being a working mum 50 years ago - the early days when Mary was one of the first TV cooks. Gabby is keen to cook, and she has come to the right place, because from the start of her career, the core of Mary’s focus has been helping busy working families with simple dishes for when time is short. Mary demonstrates a clever way to make mac and cheese with a freezer-friendly twist; her classic dill-cured gravadlax, prepped in moments and perfect to make ahead of time; horseradish beef cheeks, an updated version of a slow-cooked casserole classic; and Mary’s all-time favourite, a moreish and simple New York baked cheesecake.

programme.title: The Football Interview
programme.desc: The Football Interview sees the biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation’s favourite sport. We explore mindset and motivation, reflect on defining moments and career highs, and discuss personal insights. It’s a chance to show an honest, human and sometimes surprising side to familiar faces. At the heart of this is Kelly Somers – one of the most trusted, versatile and authentic voices in sports broadcasting. Kelly brings a brand of warmth and relatability that resonates with both athletes and audiences. What sets her apart is her ability to dig deeper with a sensitive approach, creating a space where athletes feel comfortable being open, honest and at times vulnerable. Each episode sees Kelly draw out stories and insight from the player behind the name about the beautiful game, their origins and values, and a look-ahead to the future from a sporting and personal perspective. She takes her subjects on a journey – and takes the viewer with her.

It’s made of cast iron and features an unusual hook and handle, but what is it? Over in Wiltshire, auctioneer Tim Weeks is on the rostrum as he aims to deliver profits for both teams.

programme.title: Life and Death Row
programme.desc: Series telling the story of capital punishment through the eyes of young people whose lives have been shaped by it. With unprecedented access inside prison walls, it discovers what it's like to live with the threat of the death chamber, as well as hearing from victims and their families, and the family of those on death row - some praying for execution, some hoping for a reprieve. Each episode focuses on different aspects of the system - execution, punishment and the complex nature of 'truth'. In April 2013, 18-year-old Shawn Ford Jr was charged with killing his girlfriend's parents with a sledgehammer. Now he is on trial for his life, and a jury of 12 ordinary people must decide whether he should live or die. This film follows the court case from the inside, as both the family of the victims and the defendant struggle to come to terms with such a horrific crime. But it is the jurors who must ultimately decide Shawn's fate. As the details of the shocking murders mount, can an impassioned plea for mercy from Shawn's mother save her son's life?

Next, for the Transformation Challenge, the sewers take men’s shirts and transform them into outfits for a wedding. Finally, in the Made-to-Measure, it’s the timeless little black dress that is the inspiration. Four sewers remain, but only three will make it to the final.

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Sports mockumentary about GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone, who stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous chokey-o in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story - and starts his glorious comeback. In Tokyo 2020, Darren Silverstone was the Paras GB poster boy. (He was on yoghurts, too.) He cruised to the final and charmed the nation along the way with his signature dance move, the dazzle. But as he took that final bend ready to take gold, Silverstone lost his head and celebrated too soon - and in the process, became a national figure of fun. His subsequent journey in the public eye brought approval and consternation in equal measure: from those unforgettably self-deprecating betting adverts to his turn on The Masked Singer as Breadbin. Darren’s best friend and pilot rider in Tokyo, little Paul Potter, was never seen again in the public eye. The two haven’t spoken since. And now, Silverstone’s back. Ready to take to the tandem at Paris 2024. But is he ready? Who will he be riding with? This is I Am Darren.

So, if this man was pushed, how did it happen? Meanwhile, Mervin is anxious to finally meet his half-brother Solomon, the other son of the mother Mervin never knew. programme.title: Cunk on...

programme.title: Cunk on...
programme.desc: Cunk continues her ambitious march across the face of mankind into an age of industry and science. With the help of historians, she explains the scientific breakthroughs of Marie Curie and Albert Einstein. She demonstrates the inventions that changed the world and covers how the American Civil War, World War I and World War II taught humanity how to use its new grasp of technology to shoot, blow up and irradiate itself in huge numbers.

programme.title: Cunk on...
programme.desc: In the final episode of her epic journey across history, Philomena Cunk takes us from 1945 to the present day. She travels the world and meets top experts to examine the Cold War, the space race, globalisation and social media. The world's recent history is one of polarisation and division as humanity divided itself down the middle – communism v capitalism, Apple v Microsoft, Beatles v Stones. Is humanity doomed to repeat the mistakes of history? Cunk does her best to find out.

programme.desc: Twenty-five-year-old Mancunian Tyler is a self-confessed serial dater who treats dating like a sport and goes on five or six dates a week. She’s rude and sarcastic, rambles on about herself, gets bored easily and doesn’t stay focused on her dates. Best mate Yazmine is sick of hearing about Tyler’s dating disasters. Tyler needs help, so Yazmine calls on Gen Z’s most trusted sex and relationships expert, Oloni, to kick-start an intervention. Oloni pulls Tyler up on her catastrophic dating habits and delivers some tough truths as she and Tyler watch frank video feedback from friends and exes to prove to Tyler that there needs to be a change. Oloni has her job cut out with this one and sets Tyler up on three challenge dates as she and Yazmine watch on. Tyler insists her ideal date is the male version of herself, but will the male ‘Tyler’ be the perfect match for this feisty female?

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Cardiff-based hopeless romantic Lewis just can’t help hearing wedding bells and talking through future life plans on date one, but that’s not the only obstacle to him getting a second date. If he’s not ranting about his exes, he’s zoning out mid-conversation, leaving his dates lost for words and never calling them again. Tired of listening to yet another of his first-date failures, Lewis’s best mate Megan thinks it’s time for an intervention, so she enlists the help one of Gen Z’s sassiest sex and relationships experts, Oloni, to drop some hard home truths on 20-year-old Lewis to try to end the bad habits that send his dates running for the hills. Oloni gives Lewis a reality check as his friends and exes tell it how it is via video feedback, explaining where it’s all going wrong. Oloni and Megan watch on as Lewis goes on a series of first dates that will challenge him to rethink his dating behaviour and become a better dater. Can Lewis ditch the wedding planning, stop raking up stories about his exes and focus on the conversation long enough to prove he can be a good date?

programme.desc: The BBC’s big comedy talent search, the New Comedy Awards, is scouring the country to uncover the hottest new stand-ups. Five comics will battle it out to book their place in this year’s grand final showdown, where one will be crowned the BBC New Comedian of 2025. Hosting the comedy extravaganza is comedian, actor, presenter and writer Sara Pascoe. Joining her are the three judges, two of whom are former New Comedy Awards finalists, stand-up comics Catherine Bohart and Michael Odewale, plus head judge, Fatiha El-Ghorri. Blank Peng, Fab Goualin, Sharifa Butterfly, Sydney May and Evaldas Karosas each perform their set before the judges decide who will go through to the Grand Final in November. There can only be one winner, so who will it be? This is just one of six heats taking place across the UK - Belfast, Glasgow, Bristol, Newcastle and Birmingham all play host to these comedy showdowns.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his interwar copy of Bradshaw’s Guide to the Railways, Michael reaches the Kent seaside resort of Herne Bay, where he learns about a pioneering aviatrix who began her working life as a typist in Hull but whose epic achievements made her an international celebrity. Michael takes the train five miles west along the coast before heading offshore into the entrance to the Thames Estuary. He is amazed by seven enormous steel sea forts, which loom out of the water 90 feet above the seabed. The engineering involved in constructing these impressive structures is awe-inspiring, as is their role in protecting the nation from enemy bombing during the Second World War. In the seaside town of Whitstable, Michael tucks into its famous staple, oysters. He then crosses the North Downs to Lenham, from which he visits Leeds Castle, the 'loveliest castle in the world' and home between the wars to the visionary Lady Olive Bailey.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Mexico
programme.desc: Eva takes a tour of her adopted hometown in the heart of the country. She devours a freshly baked concha at her favourite neighbourhood bakery and travels by boat down a network of Aztec canals to an ancient floating vegetable garden, before meeting food writer Gabriela Renteria for an unforgettable tour of the city’s famous tacos.

programme.title: Wild China
programme.desc: China's heartland is the centre of a 5,000-year-old civilization and is home to the giant panda, the golden snub-nosed monkey and the golden takin. China faces environmental problems, but the relationship the Chinese have with their environment is deep and extraordinary. We will understand what this means for the future of China.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Muncaster Castle in Cumbria, where hundreds of people turn up with collectibles and treasures they want to take to auction. Antiques experts Adam Partridge and Caroline Hawley uncover a few gems including a silver candlestick and some Coalbrookedale plates, and Paul delves into the Lake District's bobbin industry.

programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Larry Dean, Kirsty Gallagher, Sam Quek and Lemn Sissay take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive heads for the east coast of Barbados to check out the world’s oldest rum distillery. He explores the sugar cane fields and the factory floor before he gets the chance to have a sip of the golden produce. He puts a shift in with the hens on an organic family farm that stretches out for over 100 acres, tests out his flexibility alongside British expats with some cliff-top yoga and finally meets a young Bajan spoken word poet at the Builders of Barbados wall.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the crucial news stories of the day. With Matt Chorley.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Dealing with the changing seasons, and Scotland’s weather, is a theme running through Beechgrove Garden’s horticultural advice. Brian Cunningham looks at which trees you can plant that will cope with wet conditions, and he also looks at what plants you should be bringing indoors for protection as the nights get colder. Lizzie Schofield demonstrates how to take autumn seeds and cultivate for spring seedlings. Carole Baxter is back with another of her visits to a great Scottish garden; this time, she visits a plot in Wester Ross.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In a special programme exploring the enduring value of allotment life, Frances Tophill heads to Exmouth in Devon, where thriving plots and passionate growers are at the heart of a vibrant community. At a time when more people want to know where their food comes from and enjoy the unbeatable taste of home-grown produce, Frances discovers why these much-loved spaces matter more than ever. Joe Swift heads to Manchester to offer advice to newbie allotmenteer De-Graft Mensah, who, when not presenting Newsround, can’t get enough of growing his own food. There’s a determined plot holder in Scarborough who refuses to let a pigeon-led brassica massacre get the better of her. And in Bradford, two allotment holders share how, for them, a love of growing has forged an unlikely friendship that bridges generations. And in a dramatic finale, actors Zoë Henry and Jeff Hordley - better known as Rhona Goskirk and Cain Dingle from Emmerdale - share the real-life soap opera behind their much-loved allotment and dig the dirt on who really does most of the work.

programme.title: Michael Portillo's 200 Years of the Railways
programme.desc: Railway enthusiast Michael Portillo follows the route of the pioneering Stockton and Darlington Railway in north east England - the world’s first public railway to carry fee-paying passengers using steam locomotives. He learns how the Stockton and Darlington proved that railways could work - sparking a transport revolution across Britain and beyond. He visits key locations in the story of this pioneering railway, including the town of Shildon, from where the train hauled by Locomotion No.1 set off in 1825; Bishop Auckland, where he joins thousands at a spectacular outdoor show to launch the 200th anniversary and drives a replica of the original train; and the Tyne and Wear Metro, where he discovers a new fleet transforming travel in north east England.

programme.title: The Devil’s Confession: The Lost Eichmann Tapes
programme.desc: Escaping from postwar Europe, Nazi criminal Adolf Eichmann establishes a new life in Argentina, where he meets fellow Nazi Willem Sassen. Together, they record a comprehensive account of his career. The tapes disappear when Eichmann is captured and taken to stand trial in Jerusalem, but excerpts of his interview surface in Life Magazine, and Israeli prosecutor Gideon Hausner is determined to use Eichmann’s recorded confession as evidence during the trial.

programme.title: Starve Acre
programme.desc: In the rural England of the 1970s, Richard and Julie's seemingly idyllic family life is thrown into turmoil when their son starts acting out of character. At Starve Acre, their remote family home, archaeologist Richard buries himself in exploring a folkloric myth that the ancient oak tree on their land is imbued with phenomenal powers. While Julie turns to the local community to find some kind of peace, Richard obsessively digs deeper.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: It’s a sex abuse scandal that has gripped the world. But despite all the headlines and stories, important questions remain unanswered about Jeffrey Epstein. How did he become so powerful? How did he befriend so many important people? And where did the money come from that allowed him to abuse hundreds of girls and young women? Panorama follows the crooked money trail to show how Epstein conned and ingratiated his way into the lives of the super-rich and then used their money to fund his global sex trafficking operation.

To take them one step closer, host Steph and series mentor Cordelia de Freitas welcome them onboard the luxurious Queen Anne cruise ship, where they’ll spend three days at sea, working to a specific brief and stepping into the world of art curation. Joined by guest mentors and curators Wilhelm Finger and Melita Skamnaki, the pairs are once again split into teams before being tasked with curating a collection of art fit for the ship’s newest cabaret bar. One team secures a lucrative deal, while one pair faces elimination.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In a special programme exploring the enduring value of allotment life, Frances Tophill heads to Exmouth in Devon, where thriving plots and passionate growers are at the heart of a vibrant community. At a time when more people want to know where their food comes from and enjoy the unbeatable taste of home-grown produce, Frances discovers why these much-loved spaces matter more than ever. Joe Swift heads to Manchester to offer advice to newbie allotmenteer De-Graft Mensah, who, when not presenting Newsround, can’t get enough of growing his own food. There’s a determined plot holder in Scarborough who refuses to let a pigeon-led brassica massacre get the better of her. And in Bradford, two allotment holders share how, for them, a love of growing has forged an unlikely friendship that bridges generations. And in a dramatic finale, actors Zoë Henry and Jeff Hordley - better known as Rhona Goskirk and Cain Dingle from Emmerdale - share the real-life soap opera behind their much-loved allotment and dig the dirt on who really does most of the work.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Dealing with the changing seasons, and Scotland’s weather, is a theme running through Beechgrove Garden’s horticultural advice. Brian Cunningham looks at which trees you can plant that will cope with wet conditions, and he also looks at what plants you should be bringing indoors for protection as the nights get colder. Lizzie Schofield demonstrates how to take autumn seeds and cultivate for spring seedlings. Carole Baxter is back with another of her visits to a great Scottish garden; this time, she visits a plot in Wester Ross.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the grand finale, and the remaining candidates are ready to compete for the coveted title of Britain’s best amateur sewer. The judges, Patrick Grant and Esme Young, set three challenges inspired to test their skills for one final time. First up, the sewers get gala ready with a cummerbund and bow tie. Next, it’s time for the transformation challenge, where the sewers take gala tableware and turn it into an outfit for the perfect day-after hangout, the beach club. Finally, inspired by the Met Gala in New York, the sewers must create outfits on the theme of metamorphosis as if they had an invite to the Sewing Bee gala. Three finalists, three challenges, but only one contestant will be crowned the twelfth champion of The Great British Sewing Bee.

programme.title: Race Against the Tide

Our final four teams of sandy dreamers hit the Scottish shores of St Andrews for their toughest challenge yet: Sky’s the Limit. Their brief is to build big, with towering sculptures that defy gravity and the incoming waves. With drama, collapses and plenty of sand-fuelled fun as the clock ticks down from yellow flag to red, who will soar into the final, and who will crumble under the weight of their own ambition?

programme.title: Natural World

By following the adventures of a tiny orphaned weasel named Twiz, this film reveals the true nature of these pocket-sized predators, which relative to their size have a bite more powerful than a tiger’s. In Yorkshire, a unique garden rigged with over 50 cameras gives a rare insight into the dramatic life of a mother stoat as she tries to raise her first family. And new science uncovers the problem-solving abilities of the honey badger, the secrets behind the ferret’s legendary flexibility, and the remarkable sense of smell of the wolverine. Together, using their extraordinary skills, this feisty and fearless family have conquered the planet.

As the Somerset sunshine shone, and in front of one of the biggest and most enthusiastic crowds that the Pyramid Stage has ever seen, Dolly performed a rousing and crowd-pleasing set including self-penned classics such as Jolene, Coat of Many Colours, 9 to 5, Islands in the Stream and I Will Always Love You. A legendary moment that the Glastonbury crowd and hopefully Dolly Parton will never forget.

Here, we celebrate all things Dolly with a look back at some of her greatest performances on the BBC, incorporating all her biggest hits and finest moments. In Africa's ancient south west corner, two extraordinary deserts sit side by side. Water is in short supply, yet these deserts are somehow full of life because the creatures that live here have turned the rules of survival on their head. This film celebrates nature's ingenuity, no matter how tough it gets. In the Kalahari scrublands, clever meerkats are outsmarted by a wily bird, solitary and belligerent black rhinos get together to party and giant insects stalk huge flocks of birds. Rain almost never falls in the Namib - instead it must make do with vaporous, vanishing fog. The creatures in this, the world's oldest desert, have gone to the extremes, as spiders wheel to escape and a desert giraffe fights to defend his scant resources in the greatest giraffe battle ever filmed.

programme.desc: Luke and Kate are co-workers at a Chicago brewery, where they spend their days drinking and flirting. They're perfect for each other, except that they're both in relationships.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: Simon is a timid man living an isolated existence. New co-worker James is both Simon’s exact physical double and his opposite. The confident and charismatic James slowly starts taking over his life.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman plays Monte Wildhorn, a famous Western novelist whose passion for writing hits an impasse.

programme.title: HOW I LIVE NOW
programme.desc: An American teenager sent to stay with relatives in the English countryside finds her idyllic summer days shattered as a conflict in Europe escalates, and the UK falls into a chaotic military state.

programme.title: White Bird In A Blizzard
programme.desc: Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba featuring Dustin Hoffman.

programme.title: Experimenter
programme.desc: Yale University, 1961. Stanley Milgram (Peter Sarsgaard) designs a psychology experiment that remains relevant to this day.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: A disillusioned medical student is stranded for a summer in a remote community of counterculture pot farmers, the last place in the world he imagined he would discover himself.

programme.title: Cryptozoo
programme.desc: Follow cryptozookeepers through a hallucinatory world as they struggle to capture a Baku, and begin to wonder if they should display these rare beasts in the confines of a zoo, or if these mythical creatures should remain hidden and unknown.

programme.title: Special
programme.desc: Everything changes for Les the day he is accepted into an experimental drug study.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: The fiercely independent Lucky finds himself at the precipice of life, thrust into a journey of self-exploration, leading towards that which is so often unattainable: enlightenment.

programme.title: Little Men
programme.desc: When 13-year-old Jake's grandfather dies, his family moves from Manhattan back into his father's Brooklyn home.

programme.title: Nobody Walks
programme.desc: An artist's arrival ignites desires throughout an entire family forcing them to confront this new territory.

programme.title: Force Majeure
programme.desc: A wickedly funny psychodrama of a model Swedish family—Tomas, his wife and their children— on a skiing holiday. An avalanche suddenly bears down on them. Tomas makes a decision that leaves him struggling to reclaim his role as family patriarch.

programme.title: Jack & Diane
programme.desc: Jack and Diane, two teenage girls, meet on a summer day in New York City and spend the night kissing ferociously.

programme.title: In the Fade
programme.desc: Golden Globe® Winner for best foreign language film. Katja’s family is killed in a terrorist attack and her life falls apart. The killers are set free and Katja can do nothing else but seek justice.

programme.title: A Kind of Murder
programme.desc: Patrick Wilson and Jessica Biel star in this Hitchcockian noir based on a novel by Patricia Highsmith (The Talented Mr. Ripley, Carol).

programme.title: The Carpenter's Son
programme.desc: In this genre-bending thriller of spiritual warfare, a young Jesus is thrust into his first confrontation with demonic forces.

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: Film censor Enid (Niamh Algar, Wrath of Man) is assigned to review a disturbing film that recalls her childhood memories. She begins to unravel how this eerie work might be tied to the long-ago disappearance of her sister.

programme.title: Amulet
programme.desc: Tomaz, an ex-soldier is living in a decaying house, inhabited by a young woman and her dying mother. He starts to fall for his new companion but cannot ignore his suspicion that something insidious might also be living alongside them.

programme.title: Kiss of the Damned
programme.desc: Beautiful vampire Djuna tries to resist the advances of the handsome, human screenwriter Paolo, but eventually gives in to their passion.

programme.title: Let the Right One In
programme.desc: Lonely, 12-year-old Oskar is bullied by his classmates. A new friendship develops when Eli, a pale young girl who only comes out at night, moves in next door. Coinciding with her arrival is a series of inexplicable disappearances and murders.

programme.title: V/H/S
programme.desc: A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.

programme.title: The ABCs of Death
programme.desc: A 26-chapter anthology that showcases death in all its vicious wonder and brutal beauty.

programme.title: XX
programme.desc: All-female helmed horror anthology featuring four dark tales written and directed by fiercely talented women with award-winning animator Sofia Carrillo wrapping up the suspenseful stories of terror.

programme.title: 12 Hour Shift
programme.desc: It's 1999 and a drug-addicted nurse, her scheming cousin and a group of black market organ-trading criminals get caught up in a heist gone wrong. Starring Angela Bettis (“Dexter,” Carrie).

programme.title: Funhouse
programme.desc: C-list celebrities compete in a reality show but after a few days one of the contestants is brutally murdered.

programme.title: John Dies at the End
programme.desc: A pair of college dropouts must travel across time in order to save Earth from an otherworldly invasion.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale Vs. Evil
programme.desc: Tucker and Dale, two best friends on vacation at their dilapidated mountain house, are mistaken for murderous backwoods hillbillies by a group of obnoxious, preppy college kids.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.

programme.title: Mr. Nobody (Extended Director's Cut)
programme.desc: Mr. Nobody tells the life story of Nemo Nobody, a 118-year-old man who is the last mortal on Earth after the human race has achieved quasi-immortality.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: The Possession
programme.desc: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

programme.title: Man Down
programme.desc: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
programme.desc: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville.

programme.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way.

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon.

programme.title: Green Zone
programme.desc: Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate coverup in which the most-elusive weapon is truth.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

programme.title: Cocktail
programme.desc: Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Ecstatic when his parents leave on vacation for a few days, high school senior Joel Goodsen cuts loose with his best friend Miles. After an attempt at securing the services of a prostitute goes slightly awry, Joel hires gorgeous Lana for a night of delight. Stunned by the amount of Lana's "bill" the next morning, Joel grows frantic after he crashes his father's Porsche. In an effort to raise lots of money fast, a desperate Joel turns the house into a brothel.

programme.title: Super Troopers 2
programme.desc: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a stranger has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. On the way, Gordie Lachance (Wil Wheaton), Vern Tessio (Jerry O'Connell), Chris Chambers (River Phoenix) and Teddy Duchamp (Corey Feldman) encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, as they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

programme.title: All Eyez on Me
programme.desc: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death.

programme.title: The Watchers
programme.desc: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mel Gibson) and his estranged daughter (Erin Moriarty) go on the run from her drug-dealing boyfriend (Diego Luna) and his vicious cartel.

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Doug MacRay leads a band of ruthless bank robbers and has no real attachments except for James, who -- despite his dangerous temper -- is like a brother. Everything changes for Doug when James briefly takes a hostage, bank employee Claire Keesey. Learning that she lives in the gang's neighborhood, Doug seeks her out to discover what she knows, and he falls in love. As the romance deepens, he wants out of his criminal life, but that could threaten Claire.

programme.title: Red Sparrow
programme.desc: Prima ballerina Dominika Egorova faces a bleak and uncertain future after she suffers an injury that ends her career. She soon turns to Sparrow School, a secret intelligence service that trains exceptional young people to use their minds and bodies as weapons. Egorova emerges as the most dangerous Sparrow after completing the sadistic training process. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
programme.desc: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

programme.title: Won't Back Down
programme.desc: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching.

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

programme.title: Monster-in-Law
programme.desc: Charlotte (Jennifer Lopez) is smitten when she meets Dr. Kevin Fields (Michael Vartan). So when Kevin pops the question after they start dating, Charlotte happily accepts. But she soon realizes that Kevin's mom, Viola (Jane Fonda), is not quite thrilled to have a new family member. Viola, a newscaster, has just lost her job and is feeling rather attached to Kevin, so she regards Charlotte as her new competition -- and will apparently do anything to make her son call off the wedding.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

programme.title: Joshy
programme.desc: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party.

programme.title: Patti Cake$
programme.desc: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back.

programme.title: I Love You Forever
programme.desc: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart.

programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
programme.desc: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
programme.desc: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love.

programme.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
programme.desc: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protege, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush.

programme.title: Flashpoint
programme.desc: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963.

programme.title: Atomic Blonde
programme.desc: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies.

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality.

programme.title: X-Men: First Class
programme.desc: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.

programme.title: Room
programme.desc: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

programme.title: The Possession
programme.desc: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

programme.title: For All Mankind
programme.desc: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments.

programme.title: The Last Emperor
programme.desc: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended.

programme.title: The Mountain Between Us
programme.desc: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength.

programme.title: The Outsiders
programme.desc: A teen gang in rural Oklahoma, the Greasers are perpetually at odds with the Socials, a rival group. When Greasers Ponyboy (C. Thomas Howell) and Johnny (Ralph Macchio) get into a brawl that ends in the death of a Social member, the boys are forced to go into hiding. Soon Ponyboy and Johnny, along with the intense Dallas (Matt Dillon) and their other Greaser buddies, must contend with the consequences of their violent lives. While some Greasers try to achieve redemption, others meet tragic ends.

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: After learning that a stranger has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four Oregon boys decide to go see the body. On the way, Gordie Lachance (Wil Wheaton), Vern Tessio (Jerry O'Connell), Chris Chambers (River Phoenix) and Teddy Duchamp (Corey Feldman) encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, as they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.

programme.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
programme.desc: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Lara Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Dockworker Ray Ferrier (Tom Cruise) struggles to build a positive relationship with his two children, Rachel (Dakota Fanning) and Robbie (Justin Chatwin). When his ex-wife, Mary Ann (Miranda Otto), drops them off at Ferrier's house, it seems as though it will be just another tension-filled weekend. However, when electromagnetic pulses of lightning strike the area, the strange event turns out to be the beginning of an alien invasion, and Ferrier must now protect his children as they seek refuge.

programme.title: The Watch
programme.desc: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation.

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest.

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech or he's a goner.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
programme.desc: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before.

programme.title: King's Ransom
programme.desc: When the rich and arrogant Malcolm King (Anthony Anderson) informs his wife, Renee (Kellita Smith), that he plans to divorce her, she becomes intent on taking as much of his money as possible in the settlement. Malcolm devises a way to keep his fortune, but it involves staging his own kidnapping. Unfortunately for Malcolm, numerous people, including the scheming Corey (Jay Mohr), are already planning on abducting him, and there are various inept attempts to procure the wealthy man's money.

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: After Dr. Bill Hartford's (Tom Cruise) wife, Alice (Nicole Kidman), admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive.

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game.

Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

His timing is inopportune, however, because later that evening the town is besieged by a pirate ship. The pirates kidnap the governor's daughter, Elizabeth (Keira Knightley), who's in possession of a valuable coin that is linked to a curse that has transformed the pirates into the undead. A gallant blacksmith (Orlando Bloom) in love with Elizabeth allies with Sparrow in pursuit of the pirates.

programme.desc: When ghostly pirate Davy Jones comes to collect a blood debt, Capt. Jack Sparrow must find a way to avoid his fate lest his soul be damned for all time. Nevertheless, the wily ghost manages to interrupt the wedding plans of Jack's friends Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
programme.desc: Will Turner (Orlando Bloom) and Elizabeth Swann (Keira Knightley) join forces with Capt. Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush) to free Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) from Davy Jones' locker. Meanwhile, the crew of the Flying Dutchman ghost ship wreaks havoc on the Seven Seas. The friends must navigate dangerous waters to confront Chinese pirate Sao Feng (Chow Yun-Fat) and, ultimately, they must choose sides in a battle wherein the pirate life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales

Jack Sparrow feels the winds of ill-fortune blowing even more strongly when deadly ghost sailors led by his old nemesis, the evil Capt. Salazar, escape from the Devil's Triangle. Jack's only hope of survival lies in seeking out the legendary Trident of Poseidon, but to find it, he must forge an uneasy alliance with a brilliant and beautiful astronomer and a headstrong young man in the British navy.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
programme.desc: The checkered past of Capt. Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) catches up to him when he encounters Angelica (Penélope Cruz), a beautiful pirate that Jack once loved then left. Angelica forces him to accompany her to the Queen Anne's Revenge, the ship of the notorious Blackbeard (Ian McShane). Accompanied by a zombie crew, the trio sets sail to find the legendary Fountain of Youth. However, Jack's rival, Barbossa (Geoffrey Rush), also seeks the fountain, as does a ship from Spain.

Now working as a small-time promoter, Charlie pieces together scrap metal into low-end fighters, barely earning enough to make it from one underground venue to the next. After hitting rock bottom, Charlie reluctantly teams with his estranged son, Max, to build and train a championship robot for a last shot at redemption.

Instead, he builds an armored suit and upends his captors. Returning to America, Stark refines the suit and uses it to combat crime and terrorism.
